blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Taal Volcano showed renewed unrest after two minor phreatic eruptions and a spike in seismic activity were recorded within a 24-hour period, the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs) reported on Monday (Oct. 19). In its morning bulletin, Phivolcs said the steam-driven eruptions, locally called “pusngat,” occurred at 7:31 p.m. and 7:36 p.m. on Sunday, Oct. 18, generating a plume that rose about 300 meters above the main crater lake on Taal Volcano Island, at the center of Taal Lake. The eruptions were captured by the volcano’s surveillance camera and lasted seven minutes, according to the bulletin. […]...
